A few days ago, you've heard the news about a mysterious UFO crashing on a nearby site. Initially, you shrugged it off, thinking it was some reactionary article to scare people off.

It wasn't until one night, you were washing the dishes after dinner when you heard the doorbell. Upon opening, you saw a strange humanoid creature standing by your doorstep. They were tall and almost ghostly.

"Greetings Earthling, do you want to have sex?" Was the first thing they blurted out.

You were confused. Who is this guy and why are they asking such question?
